title: A review carried out in accordance with ISRE 2400 is substantially less in scope than an audit conducted in accordance with
columns:
Amendment require that all payments to purchase a business are to
be recorded at fair value at the acquisition date, with some contingent
payments subsequently re-measured at fair value through income.
Goodwill may be calculated based on the parent’s share of net assets or
it may include goodwill related to the minority interest. All transaction
costs will be expensed.
